summary: Loads auto-chat speech data from an audio stream file into a manager-held linked list. Frees any existing autochat list, rebuilds the stream file name from the current directory plus a constant suffix, opens the stream, scans its chunks, and for each chunk whose label matches one of the autochat01..autochat10 strings builds a (label buffer, list node) pair appended to the list, stopping once 10 entries are stored. Called by SessionTypeSetter (00463F70).

local_names.v2: current list node pointer during the free walk
local_names.v3: same node pointer as v2, treated as a LPVOID* to its first dword
local_names.v5: data pointer stored at node+0 during the free walk
local_names.v6: write cursor walking the file-path buffer v25
local_names.v14: audio stream context/handle struct (zero-initialized, conditionally closed and freed)
local_names.v15: section label buffer filled from byte_5EA438 then zeroed

local_names.v24: chunk read buffer consumed by ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag
local_names.v25: file-path buffer built from the directory and the autochat suffix globals

operations.description: Free the existing autochat list: walk nodes from the head this+0x1B780; each node carries a data pointer at node+0 (freed once for the inner allocation and once for the buffer object) and a next pointer at node+4; every node allocation is freed after its payload
Clear list state on the manager: head this+0x1B780, tail this+0x1B784, first-inserted backup this+0x1B788 and entry count this+0x1B78C are all reset to zero
Initialize the file-path buffer v25: first character copied from byte_5EA438, the remaining 0x1FC bytes zeroed, and the trailing word/byte v26/v27 zeroed
ZeroInitSmallStruct(v14) seeds the stream-context struct; PathTruncationUtility(v25, 511) truncates the current application directory path to its directory portion
Append the constant audio file suffix held at dword_5C5E60..dword_5C5E6C and word_5C5E70 to the directory path in v25, composing the full stream file name
AudioStreamOpen(v25, 1) opens the constructed audio stream file; the entire load proceeds only when it returns non-zero
Scan loop: while ConditionalDispatchBasedOnFlag(v24, 384) reads the next chunk from the stream into v24, the chunk label is inspected and a matching chunk produces an autochat entry
sub_5651B0(v18) inspects the current chunk; a non-zero result marks the chunk as one to skip before any label matching
Match the current chunk label with sub_5654A0 against the autochat strings from autochat01 (0x005C5E54) through autochat10 (0x005C5DE8); a match selects this chunk for loading
Build the string entry: OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(8) allocates a two-dword object initialized to 0 and -1, then StringCopyWithBufferRealloc(v15) copies the matched label into the managed buffer
Build the list node: OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12) allocates a node whose dword 0 points to the string entry, dword 1 (next) is 0 and the byte at node+8 is set to 1

Append the node to the list: when the head this+0x1B780 is non-zero the previous tail this+0x1B784 is linked to the new node, otherwise the node becomes the head and first-inserted backup this+0x1B788; the tail is updated and the entry count this+0x1B78C incremented
Stop scanning once the entry count this+0x1B78C reaches 10 (0xA), capping the loaded autochat list at ten entries
ConditionalFileHandleCloseWithFlagDispatch(v14) closes the opened audio stream when a handle was acquired
SubCallWithConditionalFieldFree(v14) conditionally frees a context field and supplies the function's final status value
